A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same work, with complete main text and Appendices A–E. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that 29 of 31 pages are identical; differences concern the version stamp and acknowledgments page.

before.justification: v2 reports original synthetic experiments, Gemma and Llama attention analyses, and Gemma 2B training results on Wiki and FlanV2, including validation perplexities in Table 2.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original experimental outcomes, including Table 2 and the supplementary model analyses in Appendices C–E.

M1.justification: The p-RoPE procedure in Section 6.1 and its implementation in Appendix D are identical. No algorithm, architecture, objective, or inference component changes.

E1.justification: Coverage remains identical: Wiki, FlanV2, synthetic queries and keys, Shakespeare prompts, and the Italian, Chinese, Python, and arithmetic prompts shown in Figure 19.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same NoPE, RoPE at both wavelengths, reversed RoPE, and partial RoPE comparisons. Appendix B.3 also retains the same Random RoPE comparison.

E3.justification: Appendix D retains 10,000 training steps, batch size 512, sequence length 8,192, and the 10% Wiki validation holdout. Metrics, model configurations, and other evaluation settings are unchanged.

E4.justification: The frequency-truncation ablations, synthetic activation-decay checks, attention-head case studies, and cross-domain frequency analyses are identical, including their appendix evidence.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical throughout the text, figures, and appendices. No repeated-run, seed, uncertainty-estimation, or significance-reporting information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains 0.75-RoPE perplexities of 4.4414 on Wiki and 6.4422 on FlanV2; appendix Tables 3–5 and all plotted results also match.

T1.justification: The definitions, propositions, theorems, and Appendix A proofs are identical. The new acknowledgment mentions conversations leading to Section 3 without changing its mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion are unchanged, retaining the same claims about attention decay, positional and semantic frequency usage, and p-RoPE.

C2.justification: Mechanistic interpretations and applicability qualifications are identical. Appendix B.5 retains the same limitations concerning incomplete mechanistic coverage, larger-context evaluation, and perplexity versus downstream performance.

D1.justification: Appendix D retains the same implementation code, dataset descriptions, preprocessing and training details. The PDFs' external link targets are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Cited works and research positioning remain identical, including the discussion of partial rotary embeddings. The added personal acknowledgment introduces no cited work or revised novelty claim.

P1.justification: v3 adds one acknowledgment sentence thanking Timothy Nguyen for initial conversations on RoPE convergence that led to Section 3. The arXiv version/date stamp also changes; scientific prose and section structure remain identical.

P2.justification: The added acknowledgment creates one extra line and slightly shifts and tightens reference spacing on page 11. All 19 figures and five tables, including appendix displays, remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 adds acknowledgment credit and makes incidental presentation updates, while retaining identical scientific exposition, methods, evidence, proofs, limitations, and reproducibility information. These localized edits establish no meaningful change in overall paper quality.
